title: Generative pipeline designs peptide modulators of AMPA and NMDA receptors
summary: A pipeline of a generative neural network, AlphaFold2 and molecular dynamics designed short receptor-selective peptides for AMPAR and NMDAR. Synthesised peptides induced concentration-dependent calcium influx in rat cortical and hippocampal cultures, blocked by CNQX and MK-801. The abstract reports weaker responses than native ligands and no binding constants.
ai_technology: Generative neural network with AlphaFold2 and molecular dynamics
organization: Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan

evidence.tested: In vitro calcium influx assays with antagonist and cross-inhibition controls in rat neuronal cultures.
evidence.unknown: Responses weaker than native ligands; no binding constants in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Generative neural network proposing peptide sequences filtered by predicted structure and simulation.
